title: Carina Barrios Supplied A Captivated Single Track, "Minute"
htmlContent:
Carina Barrios is a rising artist based in the United States with a soulful sound that captivates listeners. Her latest release, "Minute," showcases her unique style and powerful voice. The song is a heartfelt ballad that speaks to the complexities of relationships and the fleeting nature of time.

With soulful piano accompaniment, Barrios' vocals take center stage as she sings about the ups and downs of a relationship and the desire to make the most of every moment. The chorus is particularly striking, with Barrios singing, "I don't want to waste a single minute, I don't want to let this love slip away."

Barrios' talent and passion shine through in "Minute," making it a must-listen for fans of soulful ballads. With this release, Barrios cements her place as an up-and-coming artist to watch in the United States music scene.
